G0301G.def:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Ésaïe 1:1; עָמוֹס, Amos 1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B) 
__1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Matthieu 1:10. 
__2. Amos: Luc 3:25.†

G0301H.def:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Ésaïe 1:1; עָמוֹס, Amos 1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B) 
__1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Matthieu 1:10. 
__2. Amos: Luc 3:25.†

G0303.def:
ἀνά 
prep. (the rarest in NT; M, Pr., 98; MM, VGT, see word), prop., 
upwards, up, always with accusative 
__1. In phrases: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, with genitive, Matthieu 13:1-58 25:1-46, Marc 7:31, 1 Corinthiens 6:5 (M, Pr., 99), Apocalypse 7:17 [so in LXX for בְּתוׄך׃]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, 1 Corinthiens 14:27 (both found in Polyb.; cf. MGr. ἀνάμεσα). 
__2. Distrib., apiece, by: Matthieu 20:9-10, Luc 9:3 (WH om.), Luc 9:14 Luc 10:1, Jean 2:6, Apocalypse 4:8. 
__3. Adverbially ("a vulgarism," B1., § 51, 5; cf. Deiss., BS, 139 f.), ἀ. εἷς ἕκαστος, Apocalypse 21:21. 
As prefix, ἀ. signifies 
__(a) up: ἀναβαίνειν; 
__(b) to: ἀναγγέλλειν; 
__(with) anew: ἀναγεννᾶν; 
__(d) back: ἀνακάμπτειν.†

G0304.def:
ἀνα-βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX for מַעֲלָה: מַעֲלָה: 3Ki.10:19-20, 4Ki.9:13 20:9 ff, 2 Chroniques 9:18-19, Ésaïe 38:8, Eze.40:6, 49; ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀ., tit. Psaumes 120:1-7 121:1-8 122:1-9 123:1-4 124:1-8 125:1-5 126:1-6 127:1-5 128:1-6 129:1-8 130:1-8 131:1-3 132:1-18 133:1-3 134:1-3)* ;] 
__1. a going up, an ascent (Pss, ll. with ?). 
__2. a step (LXX); p1., a flight of stairs: Actes 21:35, 40. (On the formation -θμός, see MM, VGT, see word)†

G0305.def:
ἀναβαίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה ;] 
to go up, ascend, 
__(a) of persons: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, Luc 19:4; εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Marc 6:51; εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, Matthieu 20:17; εἰς τ. ἱερόν, with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luc 18:10; with mention of place of departure, Matthieu 3:16 (ἀπό), Actes 8:39 (ἐκ); 
__(b) of things, to rise, spring up, come up: a fish, Matthieu 17:27; smoke, Apocalypse 8:4; plants growing, Matthieu 13:7; metaphorically, of things coming up in one's mind (as Heb. לֵב אֵל עָלָה; 4Ki.12:4, al.), Luc 24:38, 1 Corinthiens 2:9; of prayers, Actes 10:4; messages, Actes 21:31 (for late exx., see MM, VGT, see word)

G0306.def:
ἀνα-βάλλω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 78:21 89:38 (עָבַר), 1 Rois 28:14, Psaumes 104:2 (עָטָה) ;] 
to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., Actes 24:22.†

G0307.def:
ἀνα-βιβάζω
(causal of ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for רָכַב hi., etc. ;] 
to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, Matthieu 13:48 (metaphorically, MM, VGT, see word).†

G0308.def:
ἀνα-βλέπω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא ;] 
__1. to look up: Marc 8:24, al.; before εἰς, Matthieu 14:19, al. (Xen., Plat.). 
__2. to recover sight (Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Matthieu 11:5, Jean 9:11, al

G0309.def:
ἀνά-βλεψις, -εως, ή
(ἀναβλέπω), [in LXX: Ésaïe 61:1 (פְּקַח־קוֹחַ)* ;] 
recovery of sight: Luc 4:18 (Lxx).†

G0310.def:
ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for צָעַק, זָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;] 
to cry out: Matthieu 27:46 (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0311.def:
ἀναβολή, - ῆς, ἡ
(ά αβάλλω), [in LXX for בּנף, etc. ;] 
delay: Actes 25:17 (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0312.def:
ἀν-αγγέλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi ;] 
__1. to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): Jean 5:15 (WH, εἶπεν), Actes 14:27 15:4, 2 Corinthiens 7:7 
__2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, VGT, see word), to announce, declare (LXX; Cremer, 24): Matthieu 28:11 (WH, ἀπ-), Jean 4:25 16:13-15, Actes 19:18 20:20, 27 Romains 15:21, 1 Pierre 1:12, 1 Jean 1:5.†

G0313.def:
ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Sir prol.17 א* (ΑΒאc παρα-)* ;] 
to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, 1 Pierre 1:3 1:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0314.def:
ἀνα-γινώσκω
(Attic ἀναγιγν-), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
__1. to know certainly, know again, recognize. 
__2. Of written characters, to read: Matthieu 24:15, Marc 13:14, Actes 15:31 23:34, Éphésiens 3:4; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 22:31, Marc 12:10 Luc 6:3, Jean 19:20, Actes 8:30, 32, 2 Corinthiens 1:13, Apocalypse 1:3; with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, Actes 8:28, 30; before ἐν, Matthieu 12:5 21:42, Marc 12:26 (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), Luc 10:26; before ὅτι, Matthieu 19:4 21:16; τί ἐποίησε, Matthieu 12:3, Marc 2:25; pass. 2 Corinthiens 3:2; of reading aloud (MM, VGT, see word), Luc 4:16, Actes 13:27 15:21, 2 Corinthiens 3:15, Colossiens 4:16, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:27 (M, Th., in l).†

G0315.def:
ἀναγκάζω
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Proverbes 6:7 (שֹׁטֵר), I Esther 3:24, 1Ma.2:25, al. ;] 
to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: with accusative, 2 Corinthiens 12:11; id. with inf., Matthieu 14:22, Marc 6:45, Luc 14:23, Actes 26:11 (on the imperfect here, see Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), Galates 2:14 6:12; pass., C. inf., Actes 28:19, Galates 2:3 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0316.def:
ἀναγκαῖος, -αῖα, -αῖον
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Esther 8:13, Wis.16:3, Sir prol.22, 2Ma.4:23 2Mac 9:21, 4Ma.1:2 * ;] 
__1. necessary: Actes 13:46, 1 Corinthiens 12:22, 2 Corinthiens 9:5, Philippiens 2:25, Tite 3:14, Hébreux 8:3; comp. -αιότερον, Philippiens 1:24. 
__2. Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, Actes 10:24.†

G0317.def:
ἀναγκαστῶς 
adv., 
necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, 1 Pierre 5:2 (rare).†

G0318.def:
ἀνάγκη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for מָצוֹק, צַר ;] 
__1. necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, Luc 14:18 23:17 (Rec., R, mg.), 1 Corinthiens 7:37, Ju 3, Hébreux 7:27; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, 2 Corinthiens 9:7, Hébreux 7:12, Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, 1 Corinthiens 9:16; with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), Matthieu 18:7, Romains 13:5, Hébreux 9:16, 23 
__2. force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; see M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, see word; cf. θλίψις): Luc 21:23, 1 Corinthiens 7:26, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:7; pl. (see B1., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), ἐν ἀ., 2 Corinthiens 6:4 12:10.†

G0319.def:
ἀνα-γνωρίζω 
[in LXX: Genèse 45:1 (יָדַע hith.)* ;] 
to recognize: Actes 7:13 (WH, txt., ἐγνωρίσθη).†

G0320.def:
ἀνά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ 
[in LXX: Néhémie 8:8 (מִקְרָא), I Esther 9:48, Sir prol. 9, 13 * ;] 
__1. recognition (Hdt.). 
__2. reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): Actes 13:15, 2 Corinthiens 3:14, 1 Timothée 4:13 (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0321.def:
ἀν-άγω 
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi. ;] 
to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., Matthieu 4:1, Luc 2:22 4:5 (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), Actes 9:39 16:34; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, Romains 10:7, Hébreux 13:20; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, Actes 12:4 (MM, VGT, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, Actes 7:41. Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: Luc 8:22, Actes 13:13 16:11 18:21 20:3, 13 21:1-2 27:2, 4 27:12, 21 28:10-11 (cf.ἐπ-ανάγω).†

G0322.def:
ἀνα-δείκνυμι 
[in LXX: Habacuc 3:2 (יָדַע), Dan LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), Daniel 1:20 (מָצָא), 1Esdra.6.2, 3Mac.9 * ;] 
__1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. 2Ma.2:8, see MM, VGT, see word): Actes 1:24. 
__2. to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): Luc 10:1.†

G0323.def:
ἀνά-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Sir.43:6 * ;] 
a sheaving forth, announcement: Luc 1:80.†

G0324.def:
ἀνα-δέχομαι 
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:19 2Mac 8:36 * ;] 
__1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, Hébreux 11:17. 
__2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, Actes 28:7.†

G0325.def:
ἀνα-δίδωμι 
[in LXX: Sir.1:22, 2Ma.13:15 * ;] 
__1. to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.). 
__2. to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, see word): Actes 23:33.†

G0326.def:
ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ 
[in Al.: Genèse 45:27 * ;] 
to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, Luc 15:24 (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, Romains 7:9.†

G0327.def:
ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Job 3:4 (דָּרַשׁ), Job 10:6 (בָּקַשׁ pi.), 2Ma.13:21 * ;] 
to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): Luc 2:44-45 Actes 11:25.†

G0328.def:
ἀνα-ζώννυμι 
[in LXX: Juges 18:16, Proverbes 31:17 (חָגַר)* ;] 
to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, 1 Pierre 1:13.†

G0329.def:
ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ
(ζωός, πῦρ), [in LXX: 1Ma.13:7 * ;] 
to kindle afresh: metaphorically, 2 Timothée 1:6 (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0330.def:
ἀνα-θάλλω
(θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: Psaumes 28:7 (עָלַז), Eze.17:24 (פָּרַח hi.), Osée 8:9, Wis.4:4, Sir.5:1-15 * ;] 
to revive: Philippiens 4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).†

G0332.def:
ἀνα-θεματίζω
(ἀνίθεμα), [in LXX chiefly for חָרַם hi. (Nombres 21:2, 1 Rois 15:3, al.), 1Ma.5:5 ;] 
to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema: absol., Marc 14:71; ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: Actes 23:12, 14 23:21 (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0333.def:
ἀνα-θεωρέω, -ῶ 
to observe carefully, consider well: Actes 17:23, Hébreux 13:7 (Diod., al.).†

G0334.def:
ἀνάθημα, -τος, τό
(cf. ἀνάθημα, and see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX often as seel. for ἀνάθεμα (חָרַם), and in Nombres 21:3, Juges 1:17 for חׇרְמָה, but prop. in 3Ma.3:17, al. ;] 
a gift set up in a temple, a votive offering: Luc 21:5 (LT, -θεμα).†

G0335.def:
ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ 
(αἰδώς), [in LXX: Sir.25:22 * ;] 
shamelessness, importunity: Luc 11:8 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0336.def:
ἀν-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναιρέω), [in LXX: Nombres 11:15 (הָרַג), Juges 15:17 (רָמָה), Jdth.15:4, 2Ma.5:13 * ;] 
__1. a taking up or away (Thuc.). 
__2. a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, see word): Actes 8:1.†

G0338.def:
ἀν-αίτιος, -ον
(αἰτία), [in LXX: Deutéronome 19:10, 13 21:8-9 (נָקִי), Dan LXX TH Sus1:62, always of αἷμα (of. MM, VGT, see word)* ;] 
guiltless, innocent: Matthieu 12:5, 7.†

G0339.def:
ἀνα-καθ-ίζω
(see: καθίζω); 
__1. trans., to set up. 
__2. Intrans., to sit up: Luc 7:15 (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), Actes 9:40 (frequently in medical writings: MM, VGT, see word).
†

G0340.def:
ἀνα-καινίζω
(καινός), [in LXX: 2 Chroniques 15:8, Psaumes 103:5 104:30, La 5:21 (חָדַשׁ pi., hith)., Psaumes 39:2 (עָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:9 * ;] 
to renew: Hébreux 6:6 (Isocr., Plut.).†

G0341.def:
ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ
= ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, see word), 
to make new: 2 Corinthiens 4:16, Colossiens 3:10 (see Cremer, 323).†

G0342.def:
ἀνακαίνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνακαινόω), 
renewal: Romains 12:2, Tite 3:5 (Cremer, 324; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: παλινγενεσία, in NT, new birth, of which ἀ. is the conse­quent renewal or renovation, in which man as well as God takes part (see Tr., Syn., § xviii)

G0343.def:
ἀνα-καλύπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi. ;] 
to unveil: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, 2 Corinthiens 3:14 3:18.†

G0344.def:
ἀνα-κάμπτω 
[in LXX: 1 Chroniques 19:5, Jérémie 3:1, al. (שׁוּב), Jérémie 15:5 (סוּר) ;] 
__1. trans., to bend or turn back. 
__2. Intrans., to return: Matthieu 2:12, Actes 18:21, Hébreux 11:15; metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Luc 10:6.†

G0345.def:
ἀνά-κειμαι 
[in LXX: I Esther 4:10, Tob.9:6 א * ;] 
__1. in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, to be laid up, laid: Marc 5:40 Rec. 
__2. In late writers (cf. MM, VGT, see word) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, to recline at table: Matthieu 26:20; part. ἀνακείμενος, Matthieu 9:10 22:10-11 26:7, Marc 6:26 14:18 16:14, Luc 22:27, Jean 6:11 12:2 13:23, 28.†
SYN.: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in Jean 13:25 differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. Jean 13:23) by indicating a change of position.

G0346.def:
ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω, ῶ
(see: κεφαλαιόω) [in Th., Al.: Psaumes 72:20 * ;] 
to sum up, gather up, present as a whole: mid., Romains 13:9, Éphésiens 1:10 (on WH. see Lft., Notes, 321 L; AR, in l; Cremer, 354, 748).†

G0347.def:
ἀνα-κλίνω 
[in LXX: 3Ma.5:16 * ;] 
to lay upon, lean against, hence, 
__(a) to lay down: Luc 2:7; 
__(b) to make to recline: Marc 6:39, WH, mg., Luc 12:37. Pass., to lie back, recline: Matthieu 8:11 14:19, Luc 13:29.† 
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀναπίπτω

G0349.def:
ἀνα-κράζω 
[in LXX for קָרָא, etc. ;] 
to cry out, shout: Marc 1:23 6:49, Luc 4:33 8:28 23:18.†

G0350.def:
ἀνα-κρίνω 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 20:12 (חָקַר), Dan LXX Su 1:13, LXX, TH Su 1:48, 51 * ;] 
to examine, investigate, question (Lft., Notes, 181 f.): Actes 17:11, 1 Corinthiens 2:14-15 4:3-4 9:3 10:25 10:27 14:24; in forensic sense (MM, VGT, see word; esp. of examination by torture; see Field, Notes, 120 f.), Luc 23:14, Actes 4:9 12:19 24:8 28:18.†
SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω

G0351.def:
ἀνά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ 
[in LXX: 3Ma.7:5 * ;] 
an examination: spec. of legal preliminary investigation, Actes 25:26 (see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0353.def:
ἀνα-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא, also for לָקַח, etc. ;] 
__1. to take up, raise: Marc 16:19, Actes 1:2, 11 1:22 10:16, 1 Timothée 3:16. 
__2. to take up, take to oneself: Actes 7:43 20:13-14 23:31, Éphésiens 6:13, 16, 2 Timothée 4:11 (for late exx., v MM, VGT, see word).†

G0354.def:
ἀνά-λημψις, -εως, ἡ 
(κοινή form of ἀνάληψις; see Th., Gr., 108 f.), 
a taking up: Luc 9:51 (MM, VGT, see word).†
ἀνά-ληψις, -εως, ἡ, Rec. for ἀνάλημψις, which see

G0355.def:
ἀν-αλίσκω
(on the etymology, see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל also for כָּלָה, etc. ;] 
__1. to expend. 
__2. to consume, destroy: Luc 9:54, Galates 5:15, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:8, Rec. WH, mg.†

G0356.def:
ἀναλογία, -ας, ἡ
(λόγος), [in Al.: Lévitique 27:1-34"18 * ;] 
proportion (MM, VGT, see word): Romains 12:6 (cf. Cremer, 397).†

G0357.def:
ἀνα-λογίζομαι 
[in LXX: Wis.17:13 א, 2Ma.12:43 A, 3Ma.7:7 * ;] 
to consider: Hébreux 12:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0358.def:
ἄναλος, -ον
(ἅλς), [in Aq.: Eze.13:10-11, 15 22:28 * ;] 
saltless, insipid: Marc 9:50.†

G0359.def:
ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναλύω), 
a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, 2 Timothée 4:6.†

G0360.def:
ἀνα-λύω
[in LXX: I Esther 3:3, Tob.2:9, Jdth.13:1, Sir.3:15, Wis.3:1-19 2:1-24,3 Mac.10 * ;] 
__1. to unloose. 
__2. to unloose for departure, depart (MM, VGT, see word): from life, Philippiens 1:23 
__3. to return, Luc 12:36.†

G0361.def:
ἀναμάρτητος, -ον
(ἁμαρτεῖν), [in LXX: Deutéronome 29:19 (18) 2Ma.8:4 2Mac 12:42 * ;] 
__1. without missing, unerring (Xen.). 
__2. In moral sense, faultless (Plat.), without sin: Jean 8:7 (see Cremer, 102, 634; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0362.def:
ἀνα-μένω 
[in LXX for קָוָה pi. ;] 
to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:10 (see M, Th., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0363.def:
ἀνα-μιμνήσκω
[in LXX for זָכַר hi. ;] 
to remind, call to one's remembrance: with accusative of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 4:17; with inf., 2 Timothée 1:6. Pass., to remember, call to mind: Marc 11:21 14:72, 2 Corinthiens 7:15, Hébreux 10:32.†

G0364.def:
ἀνάμνησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναμιμνήσκω), [in LXX: Psaumes 38:1-22 70:1-5 title. (זָכַר hi.), Lévitique 24:7 (אַזְכָּרָה), Nombres 10:10 (זִכְרוֹן), Wis.16:6 * ;] 
remembrance: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., Luc 22:19 (WH om.), 1 Corinthiens 11:24-25; ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, Hébreux 10:3 (see Abbott, Essays, 122 ff.; DCG, ii, 74a).†
SYN.: ὑπόμνησις (see Tr., Syn., § cvii).

G0365.def:
ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ
(νέος), [in LXX: Job 33:24, Esther 3:13, 1; Esdras 3:1-13, 4Ma.8:1-29 * ;] 
to renew: pass., Éphésiens 4:23 (see Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, see word)†

G0366.def:
ἀνα-νήφω 
to return to soberness: metaphorically, 2 Timothée 2:26 (of. ἐκνήφω).†

G0367G.def:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה), 
Ananias; 
__1. of Jerusalem: Actes 5:1, 3 5:5. 
__2. Of Damascus: Actes 9:10-13, 17 22:12. 
__3. High Priest: Actes 23:2 24:1.†

G0367H.def:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה), 
Ananias; 
__1. of Jerusalem: Actes 5:1, 3 5:5. 
__2. Of Damascus: Actes 9:10-13, 17 22:12. 
__3. High Priest: Actes 23:2 24:1.†

G0367I.def:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה), 
Ananias; 
__1. of Jerusalem: Actes 5:1, 3 5:5. 
__2. Of Damascus: Actes 9:10-13, 17 22:12. 
__3. High Priest: Actes 23:2 24:1.†

G0368.def:
ἀν-αντί-ρητος
(Τ, -ρρητος, -ον (ῥητός, spoken), [in Sm.: Job 11:2 33:13 * ;] 
not to be contradicted, undeniable: Actes 19:36 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0370.def:
ἀν-άξιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), [in LXX: Jérémie 15:19 א2 (זָלַל), Esther 8:13, Sir.25:8 * ;] 
unworthy: with genitive, 1 Corinthiens 6:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0371.def:
ἀναξίως
(see supr.), adv., [in LXX: 2Ma.14:42 * ;] 
in an unworthy manner: 1 Corinthiens 11:27.†

G0372.def:
ἀνά-παυσις, -εως, ή
(ἀνάπαύω) [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ and its derivatives, שַׁבָּת and its cognates (Ex, Le) ;] 
cessation, rest, refreshment: Matthieu 11:26 12:43, Luc 11:24, Apocalypse 4:8 14:11.†
SYN.: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavour­able conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ., the rest which comes from the temporary cessation of labour (see Tr., Stn., § xl; Cremer, 827; MM, VGT, see word)

G0373.def:
ἀνα-παύω, 
[in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן, etc. ;] 
to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: Matthieu 11:28, 1 Corinthiens 16:18, Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, 2 Corinthiens 7:13. Mid., to take rest, enjoy rest: Matthieu 26:45, Marc 6:31 14:41, Luc 12:19, Apocalypse 6:11 14:13; as in Heb. ofIs 11:2 (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ., 1 Pierre 4:14. (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; see MM, VGT, see word; and cf. Le 2634 f.; Cremer, 826.)†

G0374.def:
ἀνα-πείθω 
[in LXX: Jérémie 29:8 (נָשָׁא hi.), 1Ma.1:11 * ;] 
to per­suade, incite: Actes 18:13 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†

G0375.def:
ἀνα-πέμπω 
__1. to send up, 
__(a) to a higher place (Æsch., Plat., al.); 
__(b) to a higher authority (Deiss., BS, 229; MM, VGT, see word; cf. also Field, Notes, 140): Luc 23:7, 15, Actes 25:21. 
__2. to send back (Pind.): Luc 23:11, Phm 11.†

G0376.def:
ἀνά-πηρος (WH, -ειρος; see Field, Notes, 67), -ον (πηρός, maimed)
[in LXX: Tob.14:2 א, 2Ma.8:24 * ;] 
maimed, crippled: Luc 14:13, 21.†

G0377.def:
ἀνα-πίπτω 
[in LXX: Genèse 49:9 (כָּרַע) Tob.2:1 7:8, Jdth.12:10, Sir.25:18 32:2, Da TH Sus 1:37 * ;] 
__1. (cl.) to fall back. 
__2. In late writers = ἀνα-κλίνομαι, to recline for a repast (MM, VGT, see word): at table, Luc 11:37 14:10 17:7 22:14, Jean 13:12 21:20; on the ground, Matthieu 15:35 Marc 6:40 8:6 Jean 6:10; to lean back, Jean 13:25 (T, ἐπιπεσών; see: ἀνάκειμαι, ad fin.).† 
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀνακλίνομαι

G0378.def:
ἀνα-πληρόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, Lévitique 12:6, al.; also שָׁלַם (Genèse 15:16, 3Ki.7:51, Ésaïe 60:20), etc. ;] 
__1. to fill up, make full (in π. of com­pleting contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, see word): τόπον, take one's place (cf. Heb. מָקוֹם שָׁלַם), 1 Corinthiens 14:16; άμαρτίας, complete the number, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:16; τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, Galates 6:2; pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, Matthieu 13:14. 
__2. to supply: τό ὑστέρημα, 1 Corinthiens 16:17, Philippiens 2:30 (Cremer, 838).†

G0379.def:
ἀναπολόγητος, -ον
(ἀπολογεόμαι), 
without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., Notes, 252): Romains 1:20 2:1.†

G0380.def:
ἀνα-πτύσσω 
[in LXX for פָּרַשׂ,etc. ;] 
to unroll: τ. βιβλίον, Luc 4:17 (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).†

G0381.def:
ἀν-άπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;] 
to kindle: Luc 12:49, Jacques 3:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0383.def:
ἀνα-σείω 
[in Aq.: 1 Rois 26:19, Job 2:3; Aq., Sm.: Ésaïe 36:18 * ;] 
__1. to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., a1.). 
__2. In late writers (Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word), to stir up; metaphorically, to excite: τ. ὄχλον, Marc 15:11; τ. λαόν, Luc 23:5.†

G0384.def:
ἀνα-σκευάζω
(σκεῦος, a vessel), 
prop, to pack up baggage, hence, to dismantle, ravage, destroy; metaphorically, to unsettle, subvert (MM, VGT, see word): ψυχάς, Actes 15:24.†

G0385.def:
ἀνα-σπάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for לָקַח, עָלָה hi. ;] 
to draw up: Luc 14:5, Actes 11:10 (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0388.def:
ἀνα-σταυρόω 
__1. to impale (Hdt.). 
__2. to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.). 
__3. to crucify again: Hébreux 6:6 (see Westc., in l).†

G0389.def:
ἀνα-στενάζω 
[in LXX: La 1:4 (אָנַח ni.), Sir.25:17), Da TH Sus 1:22, 2Ma.6:30 * ;] 
to sigh deeply: Marc 8:12.†

G0390.def:
ἀνα-στρέφω 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] 
__1. to overturn: Jean 2:15. 
__2. to turn back, return: Actes 5:22 15:16. 
__3. to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: Matthieu 17:22 Rec.; metaphorically (like Heb. הָלַךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, see word), to conduct oneself, behave, live: 2 Corinthiens 1:12, Éphésiens 2:3, 1 Timothée 3:15, Hébreux 10:33 13:18, 1 Pierre 1:17, 2 Pierre 2:18.
† SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω

G0391.def:
ἀνα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(ἀναστρέφομαι) [in LXX: Tob.4:14, 2Ma.5:8 2Mac 6:23 * ;] 
__1. a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.). 
__2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on Jacques 3:13; MM, VGT, see word), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: Galates 1:13, Éphésiens 4:22, 1 Timothée 4:12, Hébreux 13:7, Jacques 3:13, 1 Pierre 1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16, 2 Pierre 2:7 3:11.†

G0392.def:
ἀνα-τάσσομαι 
[in LXX only as seel. (Ald.) in Ecclésiaste 2:20 ;] 
to arrange in order, bring together from memory (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, see word): Luc 1:1.†

G0393.def:
ἀνα-τέλλω 
[in LXX for צָמַח, פָּרַח, זָרַח, etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to cause to rise: Matthieu 5:45. 
__2. Intrans., to rise: φῶς, Matthieu 4:16 (= Ésaïe 9:1); ὁ ἥλιος, Matthieu 13:6, Marc 4:6 16:2, Jacques 1:11; νεφέλη, Luc 12:54; φωσφόρος, 2 Pierre 1:19; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, Hébreux 7:14 (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†

G0394.def:
ἀνα-τίθημι 
[in LXX chiefly for חָרַם (Cremer, 546) ;] 
to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; see also MM, VGT, see word), to set forth, declare: Actes 25:14, Galates 2:2.†

G0395.def:
ἀνατολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνατέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָח קָדִים ;] 
__1. a rising: of light, Luc 1:78. 
__2. the sun-rising, the east (MM, VGT, see word): Matthieu 2:2, 9, Apocalypse 21:13; ἀ. ἡλίου, Apocalypse 7:2 16:12 (WΗ, p1.); pl., Matthieu 2:1 8:11 24:27, Luc 13:29.†

G0396.def:
ἀνα-τρέπω 
[in LXX for דָּחָה, הָדַף, etc. ;] 
to overturn, destroy: Jean 2:15 WH, txt.; metaphorically, to subvert (MM, VGT, see word): 2 Timothée 2:18, Tite 1:11.†

G0397.def:
ἀνα-τρέφω 
[in LXX: Wis.7:4 B, 4Ma.10:2 4Mac 11:15 א* ;] 
to nurse up, nourish, educate, bring up: Luc 4:16, WΗ, mg., Actes 7:20-21 22:3.†

G0398.def:
ἀνα-φαίνομαι 
[in LXX for צָדַק hi., גָּלַשׁ ;] 
to bring to light, make to appear: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. having sighted C.: Actes 21:3 WH; pass., to appear, be made manifest: Luc 19:11

G0399.def:
ἀνα-φέρω 
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for קָטַר hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to carry or lead up: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 17:1, Marc 9:2; pass., Luc 24:51 (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπί τ. ξύλον (see Deiss., 135, 88 f.; ICC, in l; MM, VGT, see word): 1 Pierre 2:24. 
__2. In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer (see Hort on 1Pe, l.with): θυσίας, etc., Hébreux 7:27 13:15, 1 Pierre 2:5; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, Jacques 2:21 (see Mayor, in l). 
__3. to bear, sustain (cf. Nombres 14:33, Ésaïe 53:12): Hébreux 9:28.†
